title: Owner: apply the security baseline to the repositories
goal: The owner turns on the baseline settings and the audit shows no gap
acceptance: The owner runs the commands of the baseline page for each repository (secret scanning and push protection on project-harness, coordinator, gauntlet-protocol and grover; Dependabot alerts and security updates on all nine; CodeQL default setup where code exists)
The cross-project audit check reports no gap for the nine repositories; a refusal or a paid-plan limit is recorded with the repository
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: The audit check shows no gap
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report marks it "1 h + owner"; nine repositories, a few commands each. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
